rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for making an abstract scope, such as knowledge or horizons, broader.

example.english: Reading more books can broaden your horizons.
example.traditional: 多睇書可以擴闊你嘅眼界。
example.jyutping: do1 tai2 syu1 ho2 ji5 gwok3 fut3 nei5 ge3 ngaan5 gaai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial verb when physically making something such as a road or opening wider.

example.english: We need to broaden the road first so the bus can get through.
example.traditional: 要整闊條路先夠位畀架巴士過。
example.jyutping: jiu3 zing2 fut3 tiu4 lou6 sin1 gau3 wai2 bei2 gaa3 baa1 si2 gwo3

rows.note: Use this when something itself becomes wider, especially gradually, rather than when someone widens it.

example.english: The river has started to broaden gradually in recent years.
example.jyutping: tiu4 ho4 gan6 nin4 maan6 maan6 bin3 fut3 zo2
